target_customer: Mid-market finance teams, SMBs, fractional CFOs and accounting firms moving beyond spreadsheets
problem: Financial models in spreadsheets are hard to share, scenario test and update. Logica offers visual, collaborative drag-and-drop financial modeling with plan versus actual.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with Basic, Business and Enterprise tiers

founders.name: Carissa Castro
education: University of Nebraska-Lincoln, BS Chemical Engineering
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page; completed an online software development certificate.

founders.name: Leandro Castro
previous_startups: Deep tech engineering software company (acquired by Siemens)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page; advisor to Anzu Partners.

competitors.name: Finmark
competitors.what: Financial modeling and planning software aimed at startups

technical_complexity.rationale: A visual modeling canvas with a calculation engine and accounting integrations is moderately hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Models stored in the tool create some lock-in, but several funded FP&A tools competed on the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent action; Logica remained a small active company.

market_need_then: Spreadsheets dominated planning at SMBs and the company contrasts itself with rigid enterprise tools; no dated demand data found beyond the Finmark funding news in 2020.

branding.domain_note: Uses logica.cloud, not logica.com; the Logica name is also the former IT consultancy acquired by CGI in 2012.

brand_strength.rationale: Shares its name with a well-known former IT consultancy and many other firms, uses a .cloud domain, and no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Logica launched on Product Hunt in February 2021 as part of YC Winter 2021 and is still active with two listed team members and mid-market customers such as CQuence Health. No primary source confirms any round or exit, so the record shows a small steady product without evidence of venture scale traction.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (CB Insights, Employbl, Startup Seeker) list roughly 1.05M to 1.18M including a seed on 2021-03-01 with Invest Nebraska, Nelnet Ventures, YC and Tribe Capital, but no press release or company page confirms it, so no round is recorded. Outcome search found no shutdown, acquisition or layoffs for this company. Name origin not found. Founding year 2020 per YC page.
